name: research-guard
description: Cross-platform, fail-closed research workflow with instruction adherence, novelty and Skill-portability gates, constructive numerical audit, resource-aware execution, writing, figures, formal audit, and an optional local UI.

interface.shortDescription: Design research and enforce novelty, language, and evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Research Guard supports Windows, Linux, and macOS. Its executable instruction ledger preserves main-agent-selected multistep requirements, dependencies, acceptance evidence, forbidden substitutions, and user-only waivers, and blocks premature Stop or completion claims after evidence drift. It also provides authorized local-resource direction exploration with positive pilot and collision receipts; hash-bound serial resource-aware task DAGs; cross-disciplinary and education profiles; mandatory collision reruns after method/profile changes; frozen experiment metrics; target-harness frontier Skill evaluation with fail-closed quarantine, source-bound hypothesis trees, 2-3 validation rounds, one locked heldout run, and exact artifact/owner admission binding; an optional target-cell Skill portability matrix that preserves negative transfer and forbids universal extrapolation; native-subagent-first LLM assistance; claim and citation evidence; reproducibility; venue-grounded writing and figures; and 2-3-role manuscript audits. Formula work reports Lean, Pint, SymPy, Z3, and protocol behavior separately. Constructive numerical audit models sourced linear rational equations/inequalities, derives exact marginal legal intervals, and returns only complete jointly feasible anchors rechecked against every constraint. Users may explicitly enable active AI-reviewer adaptation, while a separate robustness mode blocks hidden manipulation. A separately released localhost Research Console can stream conversations with the installed Codex and Skill without adding a model, API fallback, classifier, or MCP tool.
defaultPrompt: Register every atomic requirement in this multistep research task, preserve evidence for each one, and verify completion without silently substituting weaker work.
Register my method, run a complete linked collision search, and plan the study as a serial resource-bounded workflow with frozen metrics and evidence checkpoints.
Audit this manuscript with 2-3 relevant roles; verify citations and formulas, model the sourced numerical constraints, and return marginal legal intervals plus complete jointly feasible anchors.
